title: Multi-Iteration Portfolio Redesign for a Creative Agency
excerpt: A long-term partnership delivering multiple website iterations and a custom application that scaled with the business.
challenge: A creative agency needed a portfolio website that truly reflected their design capabilities. Their existing WordPress site was slow, difficult to update, and didn't showcase their work effectively. As the agency grew, they also needed a custom internal tool to manage client projects and deliverables — something off-the-shelf tools couldn't handle.
solution: Over several years, we partnered closely with the agency to deliver multiple iterations of their portfolio website — each one evolving as their brand and client base grew. We migrated them from WordPress to Next.js, dramatically improving performance and design flexibility. We then built a custom project management application tailored to their specific workflow, including client-facing dashboards and automated reporting.
results: 3 major website iterations delivered over the partnership
Custom app reduced project coordination time by 40%
Client-facing dashboards improved transparency and retention

testimonial.quote: Each version of our site raised the bar. Sebastian didn't just build what we asked for — he challenged our thinking on user experience and pushed us toward solutions we hadn't considered. The move to Next.js was transformative, and the custom project tool he built afterward became essential to how we operate.
testimonial.author: V. Bauer
